_note: 2.3.0 (owner-approved planning/DRAFT_offscreen.md, roadmap M1 + M2): Own time. At each day change the engine (stepOffscreen) draws yesterday for every NPC with a bond: rate percent of them had something small happen (seeded per chat, day and NPC; the same on every swipe), at most once in gap + 1 days, never someone who spent `with` minutes or more of yesterday in the scene with {{user}}, nobody away from Halvard. One line goes into that NPC's $Recent as '(Own time) ...', replacing the one before; the Cast Sheet prints it for `show` days, Campus now adds it in brackets for those close enough to tell their plans, and Meanwhile uses it. No bond, Trust, Tension or reputation change. items: for = 'all' or Tension categories (data/tension.json), who = all | student | staff (everyone not a student), needs = what the text uses ({place}: a main routine row on yesterday's weekday, else the first haunt; at narrows it to those place keys; {club}: their club, {rival} / {friend}: a rivals / friends line the Connections panel shows, {thing}: a loved gift that can be bought, {wx}: yesterday's weather they love (Weather effects Full), home: has a home to write from, teach: teaches a class), not = never these NPCs. paper (2.4.0, roadmap M3): the items the Academy Newspaper's Monday "Campus life" column may print from the week before (public ones only), max lines. 2.4.1 (roadmap M4): ask = the NPC initiative reason this happening may give (ask_pct percent a day while it is at most ask_days old; never when strained, never for the initiative categories in ask_not; same placeholders as text); hurt = days in the Healing Ward after it (the Medical Centre: whereabouts, Look for, Who is here and Campus now put them there, ward = what Campus now says; its ask only while they are there), pct = the share of the draws it may come up in (hurts are rare). The text follows the NPC's name, past tense, no {{user}}, no other names.
